description: luismc-docs: SessionStart hands the agent the documentation rule; Stop warns when mapped code changed without its docs, a change note or `Docs: none` (DOCSPEC section 8.2). Opt-in: nothing happens in a project without docs/docs.json. The hooks only warn; the docs gate blocks.

hooks.command: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook_stop.py"; else python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook_stop.py"; fi
if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook_session_start.py"; else python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook_session_start.py"; fi
